record_title: Global quadratic Hausdorff stability for the planar fractional-perimeter comparison
provenance: A quantitative convex-body strengthening of the sharp planar fixed-classical-perimeter fractional-perimeter comparison proved in arXiv:2609.19052 and arXiv:2609.14513, using the chord-functional and fractional-Willmore structure of the former.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem is planar and restricted to convex bodies; the constant is not optimized, no uniform endpoint behavior in s is claimed, no higher-dimensional analogue is claimed, and no independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
